subject: We missed him while he was sleeping
preview: After we put Reuben in his crib, my wife and I would get into bed, open Apple Photos, and scroll all the way back to his birth.
name: OLW Parent Welcome V2 01 — founder-welcome

subject: The photo wasn't the whole memory
preview: My wife and I would stop on the same photo and remember different pieces of what happened around it.
name: OLW Parent Welcome V2 02 — one-photo-one-line

subject: Why Reuben's story stays private
preview: If I was going to build around our son's memories, the first promise had to be clear: parents stay in control.
name: OLW Parent Welcome V2 03 — privacy-control

subject: My wife remembers what I miss
preview: Looking at Reuben's photos together taught me that one family memory can hold two completely different details.
name: OLW Parent Welcome V2 04 — invite-caregiver

subject: What the eleven-month photo can't tell you
preview: A wooden sign can mark the month. It cannot preserve what changed, how the house felt, or what the family kept saying.
name: OLW Parent Welcome V2 05 — firsts-payoff

subject: One sentence I want Reuben to read someday
preview: I imagine Reuben reading something we wrote while he was small and hearing the people we were then.
name: OLW Parent Welcome V2 06 — letter-ritual
